devdoc.details: Graph Proxy contract used to delegate call implementation contracts and support upgrades. This contract should NOT define storage as it is managed by GraphProxyStorage. This contract implements a proxy that is upgradeable by an admin. https://docs.openzeppelin.com/upgrades-plugins/1.x/proxies#transparent-proxies-and-function-clashes

params.data: Calldata (including selector) for the function to delegatecall into the implementation

admin().details: NOTE: Only the admin and implementation can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103`

returns._0: The address of the current admin

implementation().details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc`

returns._0: The address of the current implementation for this proxy

pendingImplementation().details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0x9e5eddc59e0b171f57125ab86bee043d9128098c3a6b9adb4f2e86333c2f6f8c`

returns._0: The address of the current pending implementation for this proxy

setAdmin(address).details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function.

upgradeTo(address).details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function.

devdoc.title: Graph Proxy

acceptUpgrade().notice: Admin function for new implementation to accept its role as implementation.

acceptUpgradeAndCall(bytes).notice: Admin function for new implementation to accept its role as implementation, calling a function on the new implementation.

setAdmin(address).notice: Changes the admin of the proxy.

upgradeTo(address).notice: Upgrades to a new implementation contract.

devdoc.details: Provides the L2 version of the GRT token, meant to be minted/burned through the L2GraphTokenGateway.

params._data: Calldata for the initialization function call (including selector)

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params._account: Address from which to extract the tokens
Address to credit with the new tokens

burn(uint256).details: Destroys `amount` tokens from the caller. See {ERC20-_burn}.

burnFrom(address,uint256).details: Destroys `amount` tokens from `account`, deducting from the caller's allowance. See {ERC20-_burn} and {ERC20-allowance}. Requirements: - the caller must have allowance for ``accounts``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5,05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the value {ERC20} uses, unless {_setupDecimals} is called. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least `subtractedValue`.

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

initialize(address).details: Note some parameters have to be set separately as they are generally not expected to be available at initialization time: - gateway using setGateway - l1Address using setL1Address

params._owner: Governance address that owns this contract

params._to: Address to send the newly minted tokens

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

params._deadline: Expiration time of the signed permit (if zero, the permit will never expire, so use with caution)
params._value: Amount of tokens to approve the spender

params._gw: Address for the L2GraphTokenGateway that will be allowed to mint tokens

params._addr: Address for the GraphToken contract on L1

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. Requirements: - `sender` and `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - `sender` must have a balance of at least `amount`. - the caller must have allowance for ``sender``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

devdoc.title: L2 Graph Token Contract

BridgeBurned(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when the bridge / gateway has burned tokens, i.e. tokens were transferred back to L1

BridgeMinted(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when the bridge / gateway has minted new tokens, i.e. tokens were transferred to L2

GatewaySet(address).notice: Emitted when the address of the gateway has been updated

L1AddressSet(address).notice: Emitted when the address of the Graph Token contract on L1 has been updated

MinterAdded(address).notice: Emitted when a new minter is added

MinterRemoved(address).notice: Emitted when a minter is removed

NewOwnership(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new owner/governor has accepted their role

NewPendingOwnership(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new owner/governor has been set, but is pending acceptance

acceptOwnership().notice: Admin function for pending governor to accept role and update governor. This function must called by the pending governor.

acceptProxy(address).notice: Accept to be an implementation of proxy.

acceptProxyAndCall(address,bytes).notice: Accept to be an implementation of proxy and then call a function from the new implementation as specified by `_data`, which should be an encoded function call. This is useful to initialize new storage variables in the proxied contract.

bridgeBurn(address,uint256).notice: Decreases token supply, only callable by the L1/L2 bridge (when tokens are transferred to L1).

bridgeMint(address,uint256).notice: Increases token supply, only callable by the L1/L2 bridge (when tokens are transferred to L2)

gateway().notice: Address of the gateway (on L2) that is allowed to mint tokens

isMinter(address).notice: Return if the `_account` is a minter or not.

l1Address().notice: Address of the corresponding Graph Token contract on L1

nonces(address).notice: Nonces for permit signatures for each token holder

pendingGovernor().notice: Address of the new governor that is pending acceptance

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.notice: Approve token allowance by validating a message signed by the holder.

setGateway(address).notice: Sets the address of the L2 gateway allowed to mint tokens

setL1Address(address).notice: Sets the address of the counterpart token on L1

transferOwnership(address).notice: Admin function to begin change of governor. The `_newGovernor` must call `acceptOwnership` to finalize the transfer.
